remote_config.description: Firebase Remote Config template or fbrcm parameters-cache object accepted by the local stdin decoder

oneOf.x-fbrcm-grammar: [client@|server@]=literal physical project ID; exact mode bypasses project discovery

change-note.description: Change note for publication or the stored draft

condition.description: Set the value for this condition instead of the default value

draft.description: Save changes to a local draft instead of publishing; cannot be combined with --stateless

dry-run.description: Preview the requested mutation without applying it

filter.description: Filter parameters by mode-prefixed query (^, /, ~, =); may be repeated

no-group.description: Move parameter out of its group

plan-out.description: Write an immutable validated publication plan instead of applying the mutation

profile.description: Use profile for this invocation without changing the active profile (env: FBRCM_PROFILE); cannot be combined with --stateless

project.description: Filter template targets by optional client@ or server@ project query; may be repeated

remove-all-conditional-values.description: Remove all conditional values from matched parameters

remove-conditional-value.description: Remove a conditional value from matched parameters; may be repeated

search.description: Search parameters by name, description, values, and conditions

stateless.description: Run a supported command without profiles or application-managed local state (Firebase API token env: FBRCM_GOOGLE_ACCESS_TOKEN)

timeout.description: Maximum duration for the complete command

type.description: Parameter type: string, boolean, number, or json

yes.description: Print diff and update without confirmation
